name: Rumael, The False Neptune
description: A demon whose retinue consists of small horse-headed, muscular spirits vulnerable to fire that carry Aquam vis sordida.

name: Neqael
aliases: The Lady of the Purple Bower
description: The Lady of the Purple Bower, Corrupter of Lyonesse: a demoness (Lady of the Spirits of Deceit, Infernal Might 40) who poses as a faerie-blooded noblewoman and corrupts courtly love and etiquette.

name: Mavens of Etiquette in the Court of the Purple Bower
description: Chaste sexual demons (Tempters, Infernal Might 5) serving Neqael, who teach courtiers a distorted moral code and seduction techniques.

name: The Red Knight of Ys
description: Bringer of Requested Inundations: a demon (Lord of the Avengers of Evil, Infernal Might 30) who drowns victims and destroyed Ys and Lyonesse, but may only harm people after a treacherous mortal grants permission.

name: Lyonesse
description: A half-imaginary land corrupted by Neqael and destroyed by the Red Knight of Ys, popularly believed swallowed by the sea as divine judgment.

name: Ys
description: A kingdom destroyed by the Red Knight after its princess gave him the key to its sea defences.

name: Gwenolod
description: A kingdom destroyed by drowning by the Red Knight of Ys.

name: Merfolk of Ys
description: Tribes of merfolk (merrow) around the coasts of France who claim descent from the people of Ys and hate the Red Knight.

name: Coagulation
description: A standard demonic power (1 point, Corpus) possessed by the demons described.

name: Envisioning
description: A demonic Mentem power used, e.g., by the Red Knight to prepare his temptees in dreams.

name: Obsession
description: A demonic Vim power inflicting a vice such as destructive japery, unrequited passion or infatuation.

name: Change Form
description: A demonic power allowing a demon to take any animal or human form.

name: Trust of the Innocent
description: A demonic Mentem power making the victim believe a single plausible lie until contrary evidence appears.

name: Forked Tongue of the Serpent
description: Neqael's power making the target believe any lie until relating it to someone else.

name: Summon Mavens of the Purple Bower
description: Neqael's power to summon lesser demons, which she rules without mystical compulsion.

name: The Serpent's Oracle
description: Neqael's power duplicating any Intellego spell or understanding the immediate consequences of an act.

name: Inundation
description: The Red Knight's power to generate Creo, Muto or Rego-like Aquam or Terram effects that break sea defenses or raise waves.

name: A Little Hop, A Little Jump, A Little Skip
description: A demonic power letting a demon step through solid objects, remaining intangible for a round.

name: Mutable Gender
description: A demonic power allowing a demon to switch gender at will.

name: Infernal Might
description: The Might score of demons, e.g. Neqael 40, the Red Knight 30.

name: Vis Sordida
description: Tainted vis carried by demons, such as Aquam, Imaginem, Corpus or Perdo vis sordida.

name: Venus' Blessing
description: A Virtue possessed by the Red Knight of Ys.

name: Great Characteristic
description: A Virtue possessed by Neqael.

name: Improved Characteristics
description: A Virtue possessed by Neqael and the Mavens of Etiquette.

name: Weak-willed
description: A Flaw possessed by the Mavens of Etiquette.

name: Honorius III
description: The current pope, strongly in favour of crusading, who opposes Jews or Muslims in Christian administration and may preach a crusade against a pagan magical land.

name: Order of Preachers
description: A religious order (later the Dominican Order) trained to preach in vernacular language, which the pope sends to convert new lands.

name: Cathars
description: Heretics in southern France whom Pope Honorius III favours crushing.

name: Reconquista
description: The Christian reconquest in Iberia, supported by the pope.

name: Latin Empire
description: The Latin Empire in Constantinople, supported by the pope.

name: House Guernicus
description: Hermetic House whose powerful figures confer with Tremere and Jerbiton about cleaning up a crusade against a magical island.

name: House Tremere
description: Hermetic House consulted in crises and in favour of mass production of books.

name: House Jerbiton
description: Hermetic House that is broadly disgusted by magical book copying, seeing it as cheapening knowledge.

name: Tribunal
description: Hermetic assembly that judges magi, e.g. in scrying cases, and might cast characters out.

name: North Sea
description: The preferred location for the magical island, surrounded by kingdoms experiencing population growth and trade.

name: Paris
description: The largest city in the west of Mythic Europe, connected to the North Sea by the Seine.

name: Venice
description: A trade power that might bribe nobles into war against a rival northern emporium.

name: Atlantic Ocean
description: An alternative location for a magical island, averaging over 4000 paces deep.

name: The Wedding Ring of Gaea
description: A level 35 spell creating a vast stone ring-wall in the sea, used to make an island.

name: Purple Islands
description: Almost-mythical Atlantic islands ruled by a caste of magicians, with Magic and Faerie auras and vis.

name: Scilly Isles
description: Islands off Cornwall owned by the Abbey of Tavistock through a royal grant by Henry I.

name: Tavistock Abbey
description: Abbey in Devon that owns the Scilly Isles and founded a monastic community at Tresco.

name: Tresco
description: Island in the Scillies with a small monastic community founded by Tavistock Abbey.

name: Henry I
description: King who granted the Scilly Isles to the Abbey of Tavistock.

name: St Kilda Archipelago
description: Islands far west of Scotland with about a hundred Viking-stock inhabitants, the largest called Hirtir.

name: Outer Hebrides
description: Islands whose petty rulers might claim St Kilda.

name: Hibernia
description: Ireland; islands off its west coast may already be claimed by covenants.

name: House Diedne
description: Vanished Hermetic House believed by many to have sailed into the West and possibly built a civilization on an Atlantic island.

name: Arcadia
description: The faerie West into which House Diedne was believed to have sailed and died.

name: Antillia
description: The Isle of Seven Cities, a rectangular Atlantic island opposite Iberia founded by seven bishops fleeing the Moors, perhaps built by a magus.

name: Tartessos
description: An ancient rich port at the edge of the world whose faerie gods may rouse when a new rich port is built.

name: Gods of Tartessos
description: Old faerie gods of Tartessos who stir when player characters create a rich port at the edge of the world.

name: Baltic Sea
description: A shallow sea (60 paces) whose islands are mostly owned by kingdoms.

name: Gotland
description: Baltic island that cannot be purchased from its ruler.

name: Bornholm
description: Baltic island contested by the King of Denmark and the Bishop of Lund.

name: Ertholmene Archipelago
description: Uninhabited Baltic archipelago lacking sea room.

name: Black Sea
description: Sea between the Theban, Transylvanian and Novgorod Tribunals, with hundreds of faerie islands.

name: Snake Island
description: The only geographically stable faerie island in the Black Sea.

name: Theban Tribunal
description: Tribunal whose covenants claim all islands off Greece; it meets on Delos.

name: Transylvanian Tribunal
description: Tribunal bordering the Black Sea, whose rules enforce House Mercere's vis rights off Dalmatia.

name: Novgorod Tribunal
description: Tribunal bordering the Black Sea.

name: Mediterranean
description: Sea averaging 1630 paces deep, an alternative site for a magical island.

name: Lampedusa
description: Island southwest of Sicily once a Roman fish-sauce manufactory, perhaps with a weak Magic aura.

name: Linosa
description: Small island southwest of Sicily.

name: Lampione
description: Island southwest of Sicily said to be a stone dropped by a cyclops; may have a Faerie aura.

name: Sicily
description: Island whose king is the Holy Roman Emperor, with his court at Palermo.

name: Palermo
description: Seat of the Holy Roman Emperor's court in Sicily.

name: Holy Roman Emperor
description: Ruler who is also King of Sicily, with his court at Palermo.

name: Tunis
description: Home of strange Arabic sorcerers near Sicily.

name: Malta
description: Island ruled by a count owing fealty to the King of Sicily.

name: Balearic Islands
description: An independent taifa in 1220 with megalithic structures and a former temple to Mercury.

name: Dalmatia
description: Coast whose islands' vis rights are claimed by House Mercere.

name: House Mercere
description: Hermetic House claiming vis rights on Dalmatian islands, and largely unaffected by book-copying technology.

name: Delos
description: Aegean island once floating, tethered by Zeus; meeting place of the Theban Tribunal.

name: Zeus
description: Lord of Olympus who tethered floating Delos to the sea floor.

name: Steering A Vast Stone Dish
description: ReTe 40 Ring/Circle spell to direct the voyage of a small floating island.

name: Order of Hermes
description: The most powerful wielders of magic in the thirteenth century, whose magi might become inventors of magical technology.

name: Code of Hermes
description: Hermetic law, which uses 'scrying' to designate a proscribed use of magic.

name: Scrying
description: Intellego magic at Arcane Connection range; legally extended by the Code to any magic spying on a magus's affairs; a High Crime.

name: Arcane Connection
description: Mystical link used for scrying, remote writing and transport; can be fixed in the laboratory to last indefinitely.

name: Aegis of the Hearth
description: Covenant ritual that limits remote communication devices and foils spies.

name: Quills of Arcane Correspondence
description: A pair of matched enchanted goose quills; whatever is written with one is copied by the other.

name: Twinning the Quill
description: ReAn 19 effect in the Quills of Arcane Correspondence that mirrors the movements of one quill in the other.

name: The Unsubtle Knife
description: A silver knife invented by Atrox of Tytalus to send orders to his agents via Arcane Connections.

name: The Writing on the Wall
description: CrIm 22 effect of the Unsubtle Knife making a written message appear at a connected location, seemingly in blood.

name: Atrox of Tytalus
description: Magus of House Tytalus who invented the Unsubtle Knife; his sigil makes messages and errors appear in blood.

name: House Tytalus
description: Hermetic House whose members mostly believe knowledge must be earned, though some support book copying for its conflicts.

name: Earring of Whispering Voices
description: A silver earring scrying device letting its wearer hear a distant person's voice.

name: A Signal of Intent
description: CrIm 8 effect making a brief sound at a connected location to signal use of a scrying device.

name: The Ear for a Distant Voice
description: InIm 12 effect letting the user hear the voice of a person to whom she has an Arcane Connection.

name: The Hermetic Speculum
description: A rock-crystal sphere or mirror scrying device for seeing distant individuals; spread into general and civic use.

name: Summoning the Image of the Distant
description: InIm 17 effect of the Hermetic Speculum to see and hear a connected individual.

name: The Scrier Spied
description: InVi 29 effect of the Hermetic Speculum detecting scrying spells on its bearer.

name: The Invisible Eye Revealed
description: Spell on which The Scrier Spied is modelled.

name: The Effigy of the Errant Image
description: A small wooden statue letting the user project his image to a connected location for two-way communication.

name: The Wandering Eidolon
description: Re(In)Im 40 effect of the Effigy projecting the user's image to a distant location.

name: Haunt of the Living Ghost
description: Creo Imaginem spell usable for a similar effect to the Effigy of the Errant Image.

name: Parma Magica
description: Hermetic magic resistance, which must be suppressed to receive scrying messages and whose books Quaesitores would ban.

name: Magic Resistance
description: Resistance that scrying and transport effects must penetrate.

name: Penetration
description: Ability of an effect to overcome Magic Resistance; zero-Penetration devices avoid scrying accusations.

name: High Crime
description: Serious Hermetic offense, such as scrying on another magus.

name: Hermetic Oath
description: Oath prohibiting members from scrying on another maga.

name: Peripheral Code
description: Tribunal-specific rulings that might forbid supplying scrying magic or permit raiding supplies.

name: Town Crier's Guild
description: Guild formed to announce news using civic Specula.

name: Holy Roman Empire
description: Empire whose prince commissioned the first Hermetic Speculum.

name: Safeguard the Clandestine Conversation
description: Mu(Re)Im 10 spell muddling the images and sounds of those within a circle to outside observers and scriers.

name: Magic Theory
description: Ability needed to copy Hermetic books without corruption; Hermetic theory is incomplete.

name: Mentem
description: Form of minds; influences memories but not knowledge.

name: Intellego
description: Technique covering the acquisition of information, not information itself.

name: Herbam
description: Form relating to ink components and plant materials.

name: Terram
description: Form relating to ink components and non-living objects.

name: Animal
description: Form covering parchment and animals.

name: Rego
description: Technique used for craft magic and instant transportation.

name: Creo
description: Technique; the Red Knight's power mimics Hermetic Creo effects.

name: Muto
description: Technique; the Red Knight's power mimics Hermetic Muto effects.

name: Imaginem
description: Form of images and species, used in scrying and copying spells.

name: Aquam
description: Form of water and liquids.

name: Corpus
description: Form of the body; Rego Corpus spells move the body and what it carries.

name: Ignem
description: Form of fire, used in library study example.

name: Vim
description: Form of magic; used in Impede the Impertinent Interloper.

name: Perdo
description: Technique of destruction.

name: Inscribed Memories
description: Memories that power one's Arts and non-physical Abilities, which magic cannot transfer or create.

name: Rego Craft Magic
description: Rego magic duplicating a craftsman's work from provided raw materials, requiring a Finesse roll.

name: Finesse
description: Ability required for Rego craft magic and operating copying devices.

name: Profession: Scribe
description: Ability for copying books.

name: Organization Lore: Order of Hermes
description: Ability whose rare books Quaesitores worry about.

name: Faerie Lore
description: Ability used to know that some merfolk claim Ysian descent.

name: The First Furrow Guides the Second
description: Cr(In)Im 25 spell laying a book page's image over a blank sheet for copying; also an effect in the Superb Scrinium.

name: The Copyist's Puissant Quill
description: ReAq 5 craft magic spell making ink form words and images on a page along guidelines.

name: The Copyist's Critical Eye
description: InIm 10 spell revealing where a second text differs from the first.

name: The Superb Scrinium
description: An enchanted walnut writing desk that copies and binds an entire book in hours.

name: The Lector's Deft Hand
description: ReHe(An) 15 effect of the Superb Scrinium turning pages of the book being copied.

name: Stack the Decorated Page
description: ReHe(An) 20 effect of the Superb Scrinium moving the written sheet to the right-hand slab.

name: Binding the Mundane Codex
description: ReHe(An) 7 effect binding up to 800 sheets into a book.

name: Binding the Hermetic Codex
description: Alternative to Binding the Mundane Codex integrating resonant materials.

name: Resonance
description: Improvements to a book's quality from resonant materials or Magic aura exposure, lost when magically copied.

name: Laboratory Text
description: Records of lab work that must be copied without deviation to remain usable.

name: Summa
description: A book type with a Level; a library's best summa sets its base scores.

name: Tractatus
description: A book type, typically about 160 pages, acting as Quality experience in library rules.

name: Experimentation Table
description: Table rolled on when using hazardously copied Laboratory Texts.

name: House Bonisagus
description: Hermetic House split over book copying: some deplore it, others embrace it to disseminate breakthroughs.

name: House Flambeau
description: Hermetic House in favor of mass production of books.

name: House Ex Miscellanea
description: Hermetic House whose politically savvy members are eager for books on the Arts.

name: Mystery Houses
description: Houses whose knowledge must be won through ritual and ordeal, little affected by book copying.

name: Cow and Calf Oath
description: Hibernian ruling that book recipients will not copy it without permission; common as a gentleman's agreement.

name: Hibernian Tribunal
description: Tribunal where the Cow and Calf Oath is part of the Code.

name: Grand Tribunal
description: The Order's highest body, which has declined to rule on the Cow and Calf Oath.

name: Scribes' Guild
description: A guild scribes might found to oppose magical book copying.

name: Learned Magicians
description: Hedge wizards known for parchment amulets and calligraphic chartae who may join the scribes.

name: Hedge Wizard
description: Non-Hermetic magicians; some can fix Arcane Connections.

name: Gutenberg Printing Press
description: Historical press from 1455 used as a model for the impact of mass book production.

name: Gift of Frog's Legs
description: Spell allowing the target to jump up to 5 paces, epitomizing travel in the blink of an eye.

name: Leap of Homecoming
description: Instant transportation spell to one's sanctum.

name: Seven-League Stride
description: Instant transportation spell blockable by a 25th level Impede the Impertinent Interloper.

name: Instant Transportation
description: Magical transport rules with new guidelines by magnitude of distance.

name: Requisite
description: Additional Art required in casting, discussed for instant transportation.

name: Warping
description: Effect of constant mystical effects, avoided by designing effects for specific users.

name: Bring the Herd to Market
description: ReAn 45 spell transporting a group of animals up to seven leagues.

name: A Bridge Without Wood
description: ReCo 20 spell transporting the target up to 50 paces to a visible point.

name: The Messenger's Shortcut
description: ReCo(An) 45 spell transporting a rider and horse one league.

name: The Mobile Infantry
description: ReCo 50 spell transporting 100 men up to seven leagues; its caster was executed in a Wizard's March.

name: Wizard's March
description: Hermetic execution sentence passed by a Tribunal.

name: The Instant Harvest
description: ReHe 45 spell transporting a field's crop next to the field.

name: Rapacious Hand of the Highwayman
description: ReTe 35 spell transporting a wagon three miles, common in the Normandy Tribunal.

name: Normandy Tribunal
description: Tribunal where stealing another covenant's supplies is not forbidden and raiding is common.

name: Portage of the Eagles
description: ReTe 45 spell transporting goods to an Arcane Connection.

name: Impede the Impertinent Interloper
description: PeVi General spell cancelling instant transportation into or out of a circle.

name: The Gate of Countless Vistas
description: A stone arched doorway enchanted for instant transport to connected locations, keyed to individual users.

name: The Longest Step Made Short
description: ReCo 40 effect of the Gate of Countless Vistas transporting one person.

name: Phylactery of the Cautious Maga
description: Invested item that gathers an Arcane Connection and transports its maga to safety.

name: Shape and Material Bonus
description: Bonuses from item form and material, e.g. rock crystal for clairvoyance.

name: Lesser Enchantment
description: Single-effect enchanted item type.

name: Invested Item
description: Enchanted item prepared with vis to hold multiple effects.

name: Vis
description: Raw magical power used to prepare and enchant items.

name: Magic Aura
description: Supernatural aura; Magic and Faerie auras found on islands.

name: Faerie
description: Realm of faeries, with auras and faerie islands.

name: Infernal
description: Realm of demons.

name: Covenant
description: Hermetic community; covenants may exchange scrying and transport devices.

name: Sigil
description: A magus's personal magical signature shaping effects.

name: Mythic Europe
description: The game setting, a world of Aristotelean physics.

name: Magitech
description: Anachronistic modern-style technology realized through magic.

name: Remote Writing
description: Enchantment reproducing writing at a distant location, not construable as scrying.
